Script Progress: reported run.description: Report a job with the Node reporter. Call complete() at the end, or use Progress.run to have a throw reported as FAILED.

Script Progress: step.description: Move to a new step and set its label.

Script Progress: access.description: Record that this task touched a file, table, API or other resource, for the Access Map.

Script Progress: wrap a function.description: Progress.run form: the reporter is passed in, and a throw is reported as FAILED before it is re-thrown.
